dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request repository search was checked for WMBR and wmbr.mit.edu, KVRX and kvrx.org, and Radio K, KUOM and radiok.org before creation and returned no existing route records. Canonical domains, normalized station names, purpose-specific contact points, physical addresses and delivery modes were compared. Each station is stored as one consolidated opportunity even where both digital and physical delivery are authorized.
emailVerificationLevel: KVRX's music@kvrx.org and operations@kvrx.org addresses were confirmed as plaintext, purpose-specific contacts on its first-party Contact page; only music@kvrx.org is classified as the direct submission inbox. WMBR and Radio K expose Music Department email links through non-plaintext first-party mechanisms. Those protected addresses were not decoded, guessed or stored. Their physical routes remain usable, and Radio K's protected digital route remains manual. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, message or submission was sent; no track, audio file, ZIP, WAV, FLAC, download code, hosted link, metadata, one-sheet, artwork, EPK or biography was supplied; no physical media, package, postage purchase or shipment was prepared; no Google Drive, Dropbox, Bandcamp or other hosting session was used; no protected email address was decoded; no CAPTCHA, honeypot, human-verification, cookie, anti-bot or platform control was handled or bypassed; no payment workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
